subject: English
question_text: Suppose, you are Shimla living in Sunamgonj, Bangladesh.
guide_solution: Email writing From : shimla81@gmail.com To : adward227@gmail.com Subject : The food and food habits My dear Adward, Thank you for your letter. In your letter, you have wanted to know about our Bangladeshi food and food habits. Now I am giving you a short account of our usual foods. Rice is our staple food. We eat rice, fish curry, chicken curry, chicken roast, fried fish, boiled eggs, omelet, beef and mutton. We eat bread, loaves with vegetables, pulses or eggs for breakfast. On different occasions, we eat rich food consist of rice, meat, fish, pulses, vegetables, polao, biriani, milk and sweets. We eat our seasonal fruits. We are fond of lemon and salad. Besides, we eat different kinds of cakes. In winter, almost every family arranges a program to entertain relatives with cakes. Khitchuri (hotch potch), Khir (a kind of sweetened rice), polao, pulse and white rice are our traditional food. I shall be happy if you visit our country and enjoy our foods. No more today. Please write to me soon. Yours ever, Shimla
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 110 — Govt. S.C. Girls' High School, Sunamganj

subject: English
guide_solution: Paragraph writing E-learning E-learning means electronic learning. It is a kind of learning where a classroom, blackboard or desks are not needed. Moreover here one can be a student without a traditional book or writing pad or even pen or pencil. Dr Badrul H Khan is the guru of e-learning. He is a Bangladeshi. He says in e-learning, every step such as, registration, admission, classroom entry and exit, class work, attendance, discussion with course mates, feedback, exams and finally certification must take place electronically through computer and the Internet technology in a virtual campus. Everything is digitalized and conducted by a system called Learning Management System (LMS). So online education programmes blend various components of e-learning. The revolutionary concept of e-learning is already in its practice phase in many parts of the world. Professor Dr Badrul H Khan has developed a framework and important literatures on e- learning which have been praised by pundits worldwide including Bangladesh. Professor Khan is especially enthusiastic about the prospect of e-learning in Bangladesh. In fact, Bangladesh is going to establish the region’s first virtual university.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 110 — Govt. S.C. Girls' High School, Sunamganj
